parts.text: A student is determining the focal length f of a lens. Fig. 2.1 shows the apparatus used.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The student obtains a sharply-focused image on the screen.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) On Fig. 2.1, measure the distance v from the lens to the screen. v = ...............................................................

ms.label: 2(a)(i)
ms.text:
v = 6.(0) AND d = 8.(0) or v = 60 AND d = 80
correct matching unit

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) On Fig. 2.1, measure the distance d from the illuminated object to the screen. d = ............................................................... [2]

ms.label: 2(a)(ii)
ms.text:
v = 6.(0) AND d = 8.(0) or v = 60 AND d = 80
correct matching unit

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Fig. 2.1 is drawn 1/10 th actual size.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Calculate V , the actual distance from the lens to the screen. Record the value of V in the first row of Table 2.1.

ms.label: 2(b)(i)
ms.text:
V = 60 cm (or 10 × candidate’s v) and
D = 80 cm (or 10 × candidate’s d)
UV 1200 (ecf)

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate D , the actual distance from the illuminated object to the screen. Record the value of D in the first row of the table.

ms.label: 2(b)(ii)
ms.text:

D = 80 cm (or 10 × candidate’s d)
UV 1200 (ecf)

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate UV and record the result in the table. [2]

ms.label: 2(b)(iii)
ms.text:
V = 60 cm (or 10 × candidate’s v) and
D = 80 cm (or 10 × candidate’s d)
UV 1200 (ecf)

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student repeated the procedure with the lens at a distance U = 30.0 cm from the illuminated object. All the readings are recorded in the table. Table 2.1 U / cm V / cm UV / cm 2 D / cm 20.0 30.0 29.5 885 59.5 State one difference that you would expect to observe between the image formed on the screen when U = 20.0 cm and when U = 30.0 cm. ................................................................................................................................................... ...............................................................................................................................................[1]

ms.label: 2(c)
ms.text:
One from:
Different size
Different brightness
Sharpness / clearness / coloured edges

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) A student states that a more reliable value for the focal length is obtained if more values of U , V and D are collected, enabling a graph to be drawn of UV against D .
